findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Serving Chennai for 29+ years" (pill) above "Self drive cars in Chennai, delivered to"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): section.bg-gradient-to-b.from-brand-50 → linear-gradient(in oklab, rgb(238, 251, 248) 0%, rgb(250, 250, 247) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 33 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div#book.card.p-4 → rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.06) 0px 4px 20px -2px | label.flex.min-h-11 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | li.card.flex → rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.06) 0px 4px 20px -2px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 3 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 4, 6 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 48px (3.3vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The margins differ: 160px on the left, 185px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "₹1,800/day" (screen 3, 100% hidden); "Areas we deliver to" (screen 5, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 2 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
